skills.purpose: Establish one business purpose and its initial scoped Work tree; use for explicit setup, not for executing the product.
skills.selection: Use setup for one purpose; an explicit request for a native chat goal is separate from storing the purpose.

skills.purpose: Import one selected business pilot from existing source and work records into Work 3, preserving provenance and marking inferred intent unapproved.
skills.selection: Use for Work-format adoption from inspected source, not a database or production migration.

skills.purpose: Write and reconcile business intent, requirements, rules and acceptance for one selected business; do not treat source behavior as approved intent.
skills.selection: Use for business decisions or requirement reconciliation, not code implementation.

skills.purpose: Define selected architecture and bounded backend, frontend or data plans from approved business intent.
skills.selection: Use for architecture/code-scope design; choose only relevant backend, frontend and data branches.

skills.purpose: Plan, implement and verify selected backend and/or frontend pieces with fixed scoped branches.
skills.selection: Use for an authorized product build with existing business/architecture prerequisites.

skills.purpose: Plan, implement and visually audit a selected existing frontend using accepted design direction and real rendered evidence.
skills.selection: Use for an authorized frontend redesign, not merely a mockup or read-only critique.

skills.purpose: Plan and draw a selected visual direction or UI concept without claiming shipped code or browser UAT.
skills.selection: Use for visual exploration or a design artifact, not product implementation.

skills.purpose: Create selected content, compose it into a landing surface and inspect the actual rendered result.
skills.selection: Use when content plus landing composition is requested; do not invent claims or publish implicitly.

skills.purpose: Plan and execute selected browser flows or API acceptance, then review only the tested portfolio.
skills.selection: Choose browser for rendered-user journeys and API for API-only acceptance; never substitute API proof for UI proof.

skills.purpose: Reproduce and repair selected backend and/or frontend defects with bounded verification.
skills.selection: Use only when fixing is requested; diagnosis-only remains read-only.

skills.purpose: Plan and execute explicitly authorized fixture seeding or data migration, with scoped verification.
skills.selection: Choose seed for fixture prerequisites and migrate for authorized data migration; not Work-format import.

skills.purpose: Preflight and perform one selected runtime-serving, service-operation or identity-provisioning action, then verify its API postconditions.
skills.selection: Select exactly serve, operate or identity from the requested effect; never use for read-only status alone.

skills.purpose: Publish verified source and optionally deploy an explicitly authorized release to its exact destination.
skills.selection: Use full only for explicit publish-and-deploy scope; use publish-only when deployment is not requested.

skills.purpose: Perform one selected library maintenance, knowledge repair or scope retirement mode with bounded review.
skills.selection: Select a concrete maintenance mode, not a catch-all for unrelated changes.
